summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial statements as of and for the three months ended March 31, 2026, and for the year ended December 31, 2025, giving effect to its previously announced merger with SVRE Holdings Ltd. via a BVI merger structure. The filing is a procedural update supplementing a preliminary proxy statement filed May 13, 2026, and contains forward-looking statements. No new deal terms, price per share, premium, break fee, or board recommendation are provided. The merger agreement was signed April 19, 2026, but this filing does not announce or materially update the transaction. It is a routine pro forma disclosure pursuant to Item 8.01, not a special situation event.
